text:
Evan Bouchard is having the kind of start that puts a defenseman in history pieces. He has 41 points in 27 games, Yahoo Sports had him on the verge of tying one of Paul Coffey's streaks, and Deadspin's early awards watch had him alongside Connor McDavid at the top of the trophy picks.

Our numbers agree he is driving it and say the totals are inflated. Edmonton takes 57% of the 5v5 shot attempts with him on the ice, about 15 points better than without him, and Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among 215 defensemen last season. But he has 12 goals on 4.6 expected, shooting 17% against 10% last season, and the Oilers have scored 26 more goals than expected with him out there. We mark him due to cool.

The last week showed the other side: four Oilers games without a win, one of them with him playing 32 minutes. Daily Faceoff Edmonton called the Vegas loss one of his worst games of the year. He is still elite; the pace isn't.
headline: Evan Bouchard, scoring like a forward
